thread.title: Should You Get Rid of A10 Networks (ATEN) Now?

author: Zacks Equity Research
title: Should You Get Rid of A10 Networks (ATEN) Now?
text:
Similar to wise buying decisions, exiting certain underperformers at the right time helps maximize portfolio returns. Selling off losers can be difficult, but if both the share price and estimates are falling, it could be time to get rid of the security before more losses hit your portfolio.
One such stock that you may want to consider dropping is A10 Networks, Inc. ( ATEN - Free Report ) , which has witnessed a significant price decline in the past four weeks, and it has seen negative earnings estimate revisions for the current quarter and the current year. A Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) further confirms weakness in ATEN.
A key reason for this move has been the negative trend in earnings estimate revisions. For the full year, we have seen two estimates moving down in the past 30 days, compared with just no upward revisions. This trend has caused the consensus estimate to trend lower, going from earnings of 3 cents a share a month ago to its current level of a loss of 8 cents.
Also, for the current quarter, A10 Networks has seen one downward estimate revisions versus no revisions in the opposite direction, dragging the consensus estimate down to a loss of 2 cents a share from earnings of one cent over the past 30 days.
The stock has also seen some pretty dismal trading lately, as the share price has dropped 11.9% in the past month.

So it may not be a good decision to keep this stock in your portfolio anymore, at least if you don’t have a long time horizon to wait.
If you are still interested in the Computer and Technology sector, you may instead consider a better-ranked stock - Apple Inc. ( AAPL - Free Report ) .
